Bharat Tiwari Encounter Sparks Political Debate and Criticism

The encounter killing of Bharat Tiwari has triggered a political debate across various outlets. Leaders and activists have raised concerns, with some questioning the legality and implications of the encounter, while others defend the actions taken. The incident has also brought attention to broader issues of governance and systemic weaknesses.
